Oneliner

6 satellite constellation for HF marine data communications.
Description

HF VariSat-2 mission, operated by VariSat LLC, is to experiment and gain flight heritage with a satellite designed to support HF marine data communications. A set of 6 satellites will be launched, to test the inter satellite link aspect of the system that is envisioned, as well as test ship to satellite and satellite to surface stations.
